conservation_status.value: conservation-worthy national breed (Norwegian Forest and Landscape Institute, 2008-2010)

origin_year_or_period.value: principal Norwegian breed until 19th-century imports; refined at a breeding station 1916-1973

history_summary.value: The only chicken breed indigenous to Norway, historically the country's principal breed until foreign imports began in the nineteenth century. It was refined at a state breeding station in Jaeren between 1916 and 1973, work that made it autosexing, and it is now recognized as a conservation-worthy national breed.
